proposed.explanation:
Comparison of the four companies on net-profit growth (2024→2025) and trailing P/E:

• ETEL (Telecom Egypt): Net profit grew from 10,111,328,000 EGP to 22,578,063,000 EGP, a 123.3 % increase. EPS rose from 4.79 to 11.93 EGP. At 141.95 EGP the P/E is ≈ 11.9×.
• COMI (CIB): Net profit grew from 55,256,732,000 to 82,258,815,000 EGP, +48.9 %. EPS 14.72 → 18.25 EGP. At 128.00 EGP the P/E is ≈ 7.0×.
• EFID (Edita): Net profit grew from 1,606,727,698 to 2,695,301,670 EGP, +67.7 %. EPS 1.09 → 2.18 EGP. At 20.40 EGP the P/E is ≈ 9.4×.
• TMGH (Talaat Moustafa): Net profit grew from 12,769,517,325 to 18,201,981,482 EGP, +42.5 %. EPS 4.38 → 6.98 EGP. At 82.50 EGP the P/E is ≈ 11.8×.

Recommendation – ETEL: For a 7+ year growth mandate with medium risk tolerance, ETEL offers the strongest profit-growth signal (123 %) at a P/E (≈ 11.9×) that is not stretched relative to that growth. Telecom is an essential, regulated service, which adds a degree of earnings stability over a long horizon. COMI is the cheapest on P/E (7.0×) but its 49 % growth, while solid, is lower, and banking earnings are more cyclical. EFID shows good growth (68 %) at a fair P/E, but its absolute profit base is much smaller. TMGH has the lowest growth (43 %) and a P/E (11.8×) that is not clearly cheaper than ETEL's, making it the least attractive on this comparison.

Position sizing: 281 shares × 141.95 EGP = 39,887.95 EGP. Remaining cash ≈ 40,112 EGP. ETEL would represent ≈ 49.9 % of the 80,000 EGP portfolio, respecting the 50 % single-name cap.

Risks and caveats: (1) Only one year of growth is visible; the 123 % jump may partly reflect a low 2024 base or one-off items not detailed in the evidence. (2) No balance-sheet, cash-flow, or revenue data were provided, so leverage, capex needs, and revenue quality are unknown. (3) Egyptian-listed equities carry currency, regulatory, and macro risks. (4) This is a single-stock entry; the investor should consider adding a second position later to diversify further. This is guidance, not a guarantee of returns.
